arguments.Code: using UnityEngine;using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation;internal class CommandScript:IRunCommand{public void Execute(ExecutionResult result){foreach(var v in Object.FindObjectsByType<VehicleController>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)){result.Log(v.OperatorVehicleId+" pos="+v.transform.position+" rot="+v.transform.eulerAngles);foreach(var w in v.GetComponentsInChildren<WheelCollider>()){WheelHit hit;result.Log(w.name+" grounded="+w.GetGroundHit(out hit)+" hit="+(hit.collider?hit.collider.name:"none")+" motor="+w.motorTorque+" brake="+w.brakeTorque+" rpm="+w.rpm+" force="+hit.force+" slip="+hit.forwardSlip+" friction="+w.forwardFriction.stiffness+" asym="+w.forwardFriction.asymptoteValue+" normal="+hit.normal);}foreach(var c in v.GetComponentsInChildren<Collider>())if(!(c is WheelCollider))result.Log("body="+c.GetType().Name+" "+c.name+" bounds="+c.bounds);foreach(var hit in Physics.RaycastAll(v.transform.position+Vector3.up*15,Vector3.down,30))if(!hit.transform.IsChildOf(v.transform))result.Log("surface="+hit.collider.name+" at="+hit.point);} }}
